plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: test -n "$NUGET_API_KEY" || { echo 'NUGET_API_KEY is required for publication.' >&2; exit 1; }; test "${nextRelease.version}" = "$HEXALITH_RELEASE_RESERVED_VERSION" || { echo 'Semantic Release version does not match the reviewed release plan.' >&2; exit 1; }; python3 scripts/verify-nuget-publication.py eng/release-packages.json ${nextRelease.version} --expect absent
